title: 92.5 XTU Celebrates Dolly Parton Day on September 25th
summary: Bala Cynwyd, PA (9/23/2026): On Friday, September 25, 92.5 XTU (WXTU-FM) is turning up the music, the rhinestones and the Dolly spirit to celebrate Dolly
body_markdown:
**Bala Cynwyd, PA (9/23/2026):** On Friday, September 25,[92.5 XTU](https://925xtu.com/) (WXTU-FM) is turning up the music, the rhinestones and the Dolly spirit to celebrate Dolly Parton Day – a day dedicated to one of country music’s most beloved and influential icons.


Why September 25th? Because 9/25 gives a wink to Dolly’s legendary anthem, “9 to 5.” It’s the perfect day to celebrate Dolly’s music, generosity, larger-than-life personality and enduring impact on country music and beyond.


For[92.5 XTU](https://925xtu.com/) , it’s the perfect excuse to celebrate everything that makes Dolly… well, **Dolly** .


“Dolly Parton is one of those rare artists who managed to make everything feel bigger, brighter and more fun,” said Andie Summers, host of The Andie Summers Show. “Her music has been part of so many people’s lives, but it’s her heart, humor, and generosity that made her truly special. We’re going to have a lot of fun celebrating Dolly on 9/25 and on 92.5 XTU, Philly’s Country Station. BTW – I fully support going all-in on the rhinestones. It’s your day to shine!”


Throughout the day, XTU will spotlight Dolly’s unforgettable career, from classics like “Jolene,” “9 to 5,” “Coat of Many Colors” and “I Will Always Love You” to the stories, humor and heart behind the songs. Listeners are encouraged to celebrate in true Dolly fashion – with a little more kindness, a little more sparkle and a whole lot of country music.


So, grab your rhinestones, turn up the radio and get ready to celebrate a country legend.
